Removed one duplicate useMaterialize UUID assertion. React context/memo adapter remains used by the retained active-search subscription test and native browser integration.

Two index-to-anchor cases now call the real command factory directly in Node and verify the captured single anchored mutation and actual independent Results/Details order. Rendering had no ownership role in these command assertions. No browser gesture claim.

Nine search business cases now call the real deriveSearchFilter production projection directly over admitted documents and actual localized-domain values. One retained React test proves idle non-subscription, fresh snapshot upon activation, and active update invalidation using the actual mutation hook. No DOM matching or layout claim.

Retains four React subscription/memo invalidation cases, each observing both unrelated quiet changes and relevant updates. Removed initial primitive/missing-value mappings and organization ordering assertions that did not require React. Three threshold and populated nested-container cases now call the actual largeFormInitialCollapsedUuids production projection directly in Node.

Retains one actual structural subscription identity case over admitted same-store Connect mode transitions and unrelated edits. The exclusion helper business assertion moved to one direct Node case with explicit located IDs.

Removed five primitive one-line selector mapping cases without an independent behavior claim. Admitted Connect business transitions and the actual structural selector lifecycle are owned by the command/projection and Connect subscription tests.

Removed two initial absent-selection mapping cases. Retains four actual React subscription cases: history-state publication, paired entity/order projection invalidation, primitive selector invalidation, and stable imperative callback reading the latest committed document without subscription.

Five retained cases exercise actual effect-owned choice proof lifecycle: worker request/receipt binding, field-context and document invalidation, cancellation/unmount, and late or post-close completion. Controlled transport executes the actual evaluateCaseWriteVerdictBatch; receipts prove real gate admission. Worker transport control is an external boundary, and browser ErrorEvent callback delivery is not claimed as native browser proof.

Four actual React effect-owned autosave cases exercise the production store, reconciler, queue and gates. Only external transport is deferred. They prove observer subscription/status publication, timer/task ownership, unmount cancellation and prevention of late queued dispatch. Reconciliation business rules retain their direct Node tests; these cases make no native browser networking claim.
